summary: verdaccio-okta-oauth ships preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executing obfuscated Bun payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Verdaccio authentication plugin and points its repository at github.com/servicetitan/uikit, but its package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ (or uses a locally-present `bun`) and immediately runs `execFileSync(bun, [math_init.js])` against a bundled 727KB single-line file. math_init.js is a heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled CJS blob (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) using a rotated string/integer constant array (`WV8StW` rotator, `hc1jfK9` decoder with an obfuscator.io-style custom alphabet) and fully mangled `_0x`-style identifiers; it is not a build product of the small TypeScript sources shipped under src/. Fetching a second runtime at install time solely to execute an obfuscated sibling file — under a package name and repository URL that impersonate ServiceTitan's Verdaccio Okta OAuth plugin — is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern, evading Node-based supply-chain scanners and running arbitrary attacker-controlled code on every machine that installs the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
